why_no_new_terms: A clinical review of anxiety in complex PTSD in seven sections: its terms (kPTBS and the Disorders of Self-Organization, the polyvagal states, the Window of Tolerance, the five forms of anxiety, the treatments from EMDR to CFT) are borrowed clinical psychology and none is named in the novel's world. The 154 candidates the lookup found no page for stay candidates: no page is created from a review. It says nothing of Kael, the Anteile or the Kernwelten, so no page takes a reading.
decided_by_existing_rules: J12 (a compound is its own token: Angst / Bindungsangst, Furcht / Furchtextinktion), J14 (a slash in a label is an apposition: Mobilisation/Kampf-oder-Flucht, Immobilisation/Freeze/Shutdown), J21 (a scope adjective does not split a term: emotionalen Dysregulation), J24 (a plural is not a boundary: Bindungsängsten), J42 (a set is not its largest subset: PTBS / Komplexe PTBS), J48 (the whole a member belongs to is not the member: GAD / Panikstörung / Soziale Phobie (SAD) and Panikstörung), J53 (a shared head noun is not a shared referent: Angst / schambasierte soziale Angst), J60 (an acronym and its expansion are one term: EMDR (Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing)), J69 (a match that exists only after folding is no evidence: Antriebssystem (Drive/Dopamin) and EMDR; Depersonalisation and `personas`), J72 (a parenthetical index is part of the label: Bedrohungssystem (Threat/Amygdala)), J97 (a case ending is not a boundary: toxischer Scham).
